_comment: Hand-checked expected results for the full 8-invoice batch, written before running the app. Arithmetic is shown per case. Rule numbers refer to data/seed/domain.md.

reference_cases.check: Clean invoice matches the intended PO and receipt; amounts agree.
reference_cases.working: PO-1: 5 x 2000 = 10000; billed total 100.00 USD = 10000; 10000 - 10000 = 0. Matched by S1 + PO-1, not by amount (PO-2 has the same amount).

reference_cases.check: Incorrect unit price gives the expected discrepancy, linked to the invoice and the agreed price.
Duplicate is flagged and excluded from payable/recoverable totals.
reference_cases.working: Same supplier S1 and invoice number INV-1 as 'clean', which is processed first.

reference_cases.check: Missing PO reference stays unresolved with no expected amount.
reference_cases.working: No PO on the invoice. Its amount (10000) equals both PO-1 and PO-2, so an amount match would be wrong.

reference_cases.check: Correcting an extracted field reruns reconciliation and the result persists after restart.

correction.reason: Image shows Total (USD): 90.00; the extraction read 98.00.

other_cases.working: Invoice supplier S2 cites PO-1, which belongs to S1: conflicting reference. Amount equals PO-1 exactly, which must not be used to match.

PO-3: 4 x 1250 = 5000; billed 5000; difference 0. Billed quantity 4 is more than received quantity 3, so it is flagged for review. No amount is claimed for the shortfall (domain.md does not define one; see README ambiguities).
The simulated response is not JSON, so validation rejects it; the batch continues.

expected_summary_before_correction.working: Positive differences of discrepant invoices: 2000 (wrong-price) + 800 (corrected-total, before correction) + 0 (short-receipt).

expected_summary_after_correction.working: Only wrong-price has a positive difference.
